items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Susanna McCorkle introduced us to him.

ctx.x: And I haven’t heard it in 15 years since we recorded it. And we never wanted to do it but I think we might go back to that one.

Like last May we met this friend from Berlin, we’d never met him before, and Susanna McCorkle introduced us to him. And he’s a D.J. and has his own radio show over there, and plays a lot of theater music and plays jazz because he personally likes jazz. And he’s on all the time. And so he had been a fan of ours and had many of our records but had never met us, so we met him. And so now he said could I come out and do an interview with you. So he came out and we started talking about these different things. Like he…
Do you think there’s anybody writing tunes today that are going to become standards?
